# Mike's Miracle Movers, L.L.C.
> Moving company in Jacksonville, Florida (service-area business; no storefront address published). Rated 4.7/5 from 354 Google reviews. Online estimates. Asian-owned and LGBTQ+ friendly. Truck motto: "We make it look EASY!"

- Phone (call or text): (904) 710-1565
- Hours (Eastern): Mon-Fri 6 AM-10 PM; Sat 6 AM-9 PM; Sun 8 AM-8 PM. Holiday hours may vary.
- Service area: Jacksonville and Orange Park, FL, plus long-distance moves (customers report Jacksonville to Savannah, GA).
- Email / website: none currently published.
- Pricing: not published; call for an estimate.

## Services
- Local moves: Houses, townhomes and apartments across Jacksonville, Orange Park and nearby.
- Long-distance moves: Out of town? We’ve driven Jacksonville families all the way to Savannah.
- Apartments & condos: Stairs, elevators and tight hallways, handled.
- Storage unit moves: Into storage, out of storage, or straight to your new place.
- Office & commercial: Commercial and business moves: it says so right on the truck.
- Hot tubs, pianos & heavy items: Jacuzzis, pianos and the pieces nobody else wants to lift.
- Packing & wrapping: Moving blankets, shrink wrap and careful hands.
- Single items & Marketplace pickups: Bought a hutch on Marketplace? We’ll grab it and bring it home.
- Last-minute moves: Movers cancel? Deadline in two days? Call us.
- Loading & unloading help: Rented your own truck? We’ll do the heavy lifting.
